info.title: Every Inn Booking Core — internal API
info.description: Provider-owned contract of everyinn-booking-core (EI-OTA-ARCH-001 Phase 1). Internal-only: reachable exclusively through Service Bindings (no workers.dev, no Preview URLs, no routes). Every operation requires an X-EI-Caller listed in its x-callers (admin-bff everywhere; agent-core on a documented subset, ADR-013) plus the staff actor headers (Admin forwards the logged-in staff; agent-core uses bot actor 900001/receptionist, or the approving staff member for confirmations). Money is integer VND, instants are UTC ISO-8601, business dates are Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Responses are `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. Errors: { error: { code, message, request_id, details? } }.

servers.description: Service Binding (env.BOOKING.fetch) — not a public host

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scope = operation:caller:actor. Same key + same body → replay (200, replayed=true); same key + different body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. TTL 7 days.

extended.description: Only on POST /holds/{holdId}/extend: false when the requested expiry was not later than the current one (no-op).

Booking.description: Full internal booking DTO. Never contains door codes or secrets. pricing.isFinal=false while the CDP accrual result is pending (§6.7 rule 4).

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token: send as expectedVersion.

FinancialEntry.description: Append-only manual ledger entry. amount is signed (+ received, − returned); reversals copy the bucket with the opposite sign.

OutboxItem.description: Booking → CDP command (no PII: guest phone is not exposed here).

isPublic.description: AI-8: advertised by the AI receptionist and applied without a code (best eligible discount) when a search/quote asks for applyPublicPromotions.

quote.description: Never final: the stamp reward is advisory until the CDP accrual result (isFinal is always false).

promotion.description: Only with applyPublicPromotions: the public promotion applied (null = none eligible).

total.description: Only with applyPublicPromotions: subtotal − public promotion discount.

channel.description: LSB-5: booking-session channel (web | admin | chat); null for legacy bookings.

voucherCode.description: LSB-5: stamp voucher redeemed on this booking.

post.summary: Extend checkout by `hours` (default 1, legacy extend1h): fee from the rate rule unless `feeOverride` (a price the quản lí approved), claims occupancy + turnover slots. Requires a staff actor — agent-core passes the approving staff member (Telegram) or the staff who granted the auto-approval (AI-7 OD-26); the AI bot actor (900001) gets 403 HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
Read-only dry run of extend: availability of [checkout, checkout + hours] incl. the 60′ turnover before the next booking, the table fee, and the longest extension (1–6 h) that still fits.

AI-12: read-only dry run of an early check-in (side=early) or late check-out (side=late) of 1–6 h on an existing overnight / dayuse booking: availability of the added window incl. the 60′ turnover (previous / next booking, blocks, holds), the table fee, the longest adjustment that fits, and the full booking for the quản lí card. 409 CHECKIN_PASSED when an early check-in is asked after the check-in time; 422 ADJUST_NOT_APPLICABLE for hourly / custom.

AI-12: apply an early check-in (checkin_at earlier, early_checkin_hours +) or late check-out of 1–6 h: fee from the rate rule unless `feeOverride` (the price the quản lí approved, 0 = free), claims occupancy + turnover slots, recomputes the totals, audit BOOKING_ADJUSTED. Requires a HUMAN staff actor (the quản lí who approved on Telegram); the AI bot actor (900001) gets 403 HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
pending → confirmed; enqueues the CDP accrual (occurredAt = immutable booking.created_at).
Soft cancel (replaces legacy hard delete): frees inventory, records CDP outcome for counted bookings (no loyalty reversal in mock-v1).
confirmed → no_show before checkout; optional refund ≤ net received (ledger entry in the same transaction).
Legacy mark_deposit_reminder_sent (expectedVersion; naturally idempotent).
Re-arms the guest's pending CDP commands (per-guest FIFO) and delivers them now. Safe to repeat (CDP is idempotent).
deposit | payment | refund (≤ net received) | adjustment (signed, manager, reason). Projection updated in the same transaction.
Correction by an opposite entry; each entry is reversible once (DB UNIQUE); reversals are not reversible.
